reviews.text:
I always request Ms. Taguchi for my dog's grooming. Other grooming salons tend to leave her eyes too deep, but I'm always very happy with the adorable cuts she does here 🩷
My dog ​​loves all the staff and is always happy to go into the grooming salon 🐶
Thank you for your continued support.

This year marks my fifth year going to Pet Hills. Even though my dog ​​is difficult to cut, they always treat me with care and always give me a lovely finish. I can leave it to them with peace of mind, and I'm very satisfied. It's a salon I want to continue going to in the future.

I recently visited PET HILLS TOKYO for the first time. ♥️

It's a street-level store with an attached grooming salon, and carts are welcome.
I was looking for a salon that would provide temporary boarding, so I chose them.

The store was very clean, cute, and beautiful.

It was my first time there, so I was a little nervous, but the staff member at the consultation carefully listened to my concerns, which put me at ease.

While my dog ​​was in their care, they kept me updated on their progress via LINE, sending me lots of photos and videos, so I felt really reassured knowing what was going on even when I was far away.

Reservations via LINE were also convenient, and they even allowed same-day reservations for boarding.

The salon's service and atmosphere were both wonderful, so I would definitely visit again if I had the chance. 🫶🏻✧︎

Thank you so much for the other day. ♡♡

This was my first time using your services!

I initially went to the wrong store, the one in Gaienmae, and was a little late, but you were very kind and accommodating.

The treatment was done very carefully and beautifully, and I am extremely satisfied 🫧
I would like to use your services again!

This was our first time at this grooming salon!

They were very polite from the moment we arrived, and they took lots of photos of our dog while she was there! She looks so cute, and we're very happy with the result! ✨ Our dog also seemed happy to come home! They also seem to offer herbal packs, which I'm curious about(^^) We'll definitely be back!

They took lots of cute pictures for us.
The price is quite high.
Grooming for a 1.6kg Chihuahua-Poodle mix cost 25,000 yen.
All the videos they sent me showed the dog trembling, and I wondered if I had done something cruel to him.
The cypress bath and pack might be stressful for the dog the first time.
Honestly, I didn't feel it was worth the price. Once is enough.

It was my first time,
but I went from my afro to the ear-pointing cut recommended by the salon, and it was done very carefully and I ended up looking really cute.
The haircut was so cute, and they even took pictures during the treatment so I could see how it was going! ♡ The staff were also very kind!

I had my Chihuahua groomed since he's almost a year old!
I was a little worried since it was his first time getting a grooming session,
but the kind lady assisted me and I was able to leave the job with peace of mind!
The finished result was so adorable, I'm very happy!
Thank you very much ^_^
My dog ​​got a cute haircut and is now fluffy and adorable! 😽 The staff were also very kind, so I felt completely at ease leaving him there! …

This was my first time using this service.
I was so pleased with how cute it was.
I've already booked my next appointment.
Thank you again!

I saw your shop on Instagram and visited for the first time. All the staff were very kind, and I felt completely at ease leaving my pet in your care. The finished result is so cute, and I would definitely like to use your services again.

Thank you very much.
The staff were so kind and made my hair so fluffy!

This was my cat's first bath. I saw great reviews online, so I decided to give it a try. The shop was very clean, and the two ladies there were very nice. Since it was my first time there, it only took about ten minutes to register my basic information. The bath took about an hour and a half. Overall, I was very satisfied and will definitely come again!
The consultation was thorough, and I got the haircut I wanted. The finished result is very cute, and it smelled wonderful after the warm bath.

"My dog ​​was relaxed and I felt at ease!"
This was my first time using their service, but they were very attentive from the initial consultation, and I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care. I'm very happy with the finished result; my dog ​​is so fluffy and cute, and they even took photos for me! I could feel the staff's gentle words and meticulous attention to detail, and my dog ​​was relaxed throughout. I would definitely like to use their services again!

I asked for a shampoo and cut ✨

I'd like to ask them again ✨☺️✨

You carefully consulted with me about the desired outcome, and the result was even cuter than I expected! I was also happy that you took lots of photos of the herb pack 🌿 and after the grooming! Thank you for your continued support! 🩷 …

The haircut was great and the dog looked great!

I apologize for the delay in posting my review.

I had a haircut and shampoo at this salon!

Thank you for sending me the finished photos; they were so cute!

I plan to use your services again at a hotel next time!

I'm really looking forward to it. Thank you.

I came here for a cat grooming! 
The staff were very kind and took photos and videos during the treatment, so my frightened cat was able to calm down and get a shampoo!

This was my dog's first trimming session. I received a call when the session was over, and when I went to pick him up, his fur had changed and become so fluffy, it was like he was a completely different, adorable dog! I was given a video of the trimming session when I paid, and I was relieved to see how calm he looked! I would definitely like to use this service again if I have the opportunity♪

I look forward to working with you again.
They were kind, and above all, they did a great job with the cut. Unique and pretty.

At first, she seemed a little anxious, but everyone was so kind that she quickly warmed up and seemed to enjoy the bath and face mask with a happy and relaxed expression.

The results were wonderful; her skin is so soft and fluffy, and she'll be ready to welcome the new year. Thank you so much!
I really love the poodle teddy bear cut💕 Checking it out …

Thank you for making it so fluffy and exactly as I wanted.

Thank you very much.

We'll definitely be back 🥰
This luxury pet salon is located in the heart of Shibuya and Omotesando, and provides careful care so you can rest assured.
